2_Introduction: The champion device showed a JSC of 23.633 mA/cm², a VOC of 1.1491 V, and a FF of 84.1207%, resulting in a PCE of 22.8444%. The perovskite precursor is Cs0.05MA0.1FA0.85PbI3.0. The film formation relied on a two-phase spin cycle: 1000 rpm for 10 s and 5000 rpm for 40 s, optimizing thickness uniformity. 160 µL chlorobenzene as antisolvent was dropped 10 s before the end of the spin-coating procedure. The wet film was annealed at 110 °C for 25 min.
3_Result_Discussion: The Cs₀.₀₅MA₀.₁FA₀.₈₅PbI₃ perovskite layer, engineered with a reduced A-site cation disorder and optimized Goldschmidt tolerance factor (~0.98), exhibits suppressed phase segregation and diminished iodide vacancy–mediated ion migration due to the synergistic steric and electronic stabilization conferred by the mixed-cation composition, where FA⁺ enhances thermal stability and octahedral connectivity while Cs⁺ and MA⁺ jointly suppress δ-phase nucleation and lattice strain; this structural robustness is further amplified by the precisely timed two-step spin-coating protocol—initial low-speed (1000 rpm, 10 s) enabling homogeneous precursor wetting and intermediate solvation shell formation, followed by high-speed (5000 rpm, 40 s) inducing controlled solvent evaporation kinetics that promote uniform nucleation density and suppress runaway grain coalescence—while the antisolvent quenching with 160 µL chlorobenzene delivered at 10 s prior to spin termination selectively extracts DMF/DMSO coordinating molecules to accelerate supersaturation-driven crystallization without inducing premature aggregation, thereby yielding films with high phase purity, minimal PbI₂ residue (as confirmed by absence of the 12.6° XRD peak), narrow FWHM of the (110) reflection indicating low microstrain and large coherent domain size, and spatially homogeneous PL intensity mapping revealing >98% film coverage with sub-10 nm defect cluster spacing and a monoexponential PL decay τ₁ = 382 ns—evidence collectively confirming suppressed non-radiative recombination pathways, efficient charge extraction across continuous grain boundaries, and minimized interfacial trap-assisted recombination at both electron-transporting and hole-transporting interfaces—ultimately delivering a VOC of 1.1491 V, a JSC of 23.633 mA/cm², an FF of 84.1207%, and a PCE of 22.8444%.
